limitations.text: The Julius Baer Secular Outlook is explicitly labelled “marketing material” rather than independent investment research, so its analysis may reflect commercial incentives or house views rather than objective scholarship .
All figures and opinions are stated to be valid only at the publication date (2 Dec 2025) and are ‘subject to change without notice’, meaning some data may already be out-of-date or superseded  .
Performance tables and charts carry the disclaimer that ‘past performance and performance forecasts are not reliable indicators of future results’, underlining high forecast uncertainty .
The document relies partly on third-party data providers; Julius Baer offers ‘no representation or warranty’ as to completeness or accuracy, so underlying evidence may contain errors or gaps .

The Outlook does not take account of any reader’s specific objectives or financial situation and ‘does not constitute a personal recommendation’, limiting its applicability for individual decision-making .
